name: Federated Tumor Segmentation (FeTS) challenge
description: Federated benchmarking framework assessing tumor segmentation algorithms in a decentralized (federated) setting across institutions.
evaluation_method: Dice coefficient (primary), with complementary metrics like Hausdorff distance
reputation: A well-regarded challenge in federated medical imaging that is widely referenced by researchers working on federated learning and medical image segmentation.
notes: Federated setting introduces variability due to non-iid data and institutional heterogeneity; dataset and labels may vary by institution; not an LLM benchmark; performance is hardware- and data-distribution-dependent.
